spec.confirmation: prior-day trailing20 market return <0; today market >=1%; stock >6% and >market+2pp; positive body, wick<=body/3, volume>prior5 and prior10; price>=3, amount20>=30m
spec.impulse: same stock candle/liquidity rules; market daily<=0 and trailing20 including impulse<0; most recent such day 5-30 market sessions before confirmation
spec.intervening: market index at confirmation-1 below impulse close; no selection using post-confirmation prices
spec.pullback: prior close 5-20% below highest close from impulse through confirmation-1; every intervening close >=pre-impulse close; last3 volume <=70% mean from impulse through known peak
spec.resistant: entire waiting-phase maximum close-to-close drawdown <5%; every intervening close >=pre-impulse close; recovered-after-deep-dip kept separate
spec.entry: confirmation+1 market session open; upper-limit open skipped; no 9.5% cap; historical ST excluded
spec.exit: 5/10/20/30/60/120 sessions; entry is day1; hard15% stop default; T+1 and locked lower-limit delayed; same-entry no-stop control
spec.repeated: first qualifying confirmation per stock/impulse for each setup group; same-stock nonoverlap separately by horizon, using common stop/no-stop exit
spec.industry: prior-calendar-year-end dated CSRC industry snapshot; blank/future/unknown excluded; focal stock removed from peer daily returns and breadth
spec.industry_confirmation: at least20 other members; sector prior5 return beats market prior5, sector today beats market, >=60% other members up
spec.controls: same signal date, board and signal-time amount20 quartile; no eligible prior countertrend impulse; compare mean fixed-horizon event returns
spec.split: entry<=2024 and entire stop/no-stop exit<=2024 training-description; signals>=2025 retrospective validation; cross-boundary excluded
limitations: Previously inspected history, no pristine holdout or proven absorption/causality.
Current TDX price universe omits some delisted stocks.
Annual lagged classifications can be stale; CSRC industry is not a theme/concept board.
Event statistics do not model portfolio capital or imply CAGR.
